died.name: Jesus
died.cause: right before his death by crucifixion
died.last_words: It is finished. \ Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit.

died.name: Charles VIII of France
died.cause: The French king died as a result of striking his head on the lintel of a door while on his way to watch a game of real tennis.
died.last_words: I hope never again to commit a mortal sin, nor even a venial one, if I can help it.

died.name: William Davenant
died.cause: setting aside the manuscript of a new poem
died.last_words: I shall have to ask leave to desist, when I am interrupted by so great an experiment as dying.

died.name: P. T. Barnum
died.cause: when asked if he wanted a drink of water

died.name: Alexander Bogdanov
died.cause: The 54-year-old Soviet polymath and pioneer of blood transfusion died after exchanging his blood with his student who suffered from malaria and tuberculosis, presumably due to hemolytic transfusion reaction. Bogdanov's hypotheses were that the younger man's blood would rejuvenate his own aging body, and that his own blood, which he believed was resistant to tuberculosis, would treat the student's disease. The student injected with his blood made a complete recovery.

died.name: Amir-Abbas Hoveyda
died.cause: during execution after the Iranian Revolution
died.last_words: It wasn't supposed to end like this.

born.name: William Wordsworth
born.cause: referring to his daughter, who had died three years earlier
born.last_words: God bless you! Is that you, Dora?

born.name: William Ellery Channing
born.last_words: You need not be anxious concerning tonight. It will be very peaceful and quiet with me.

born.name: Lothar Sieber
born.cause: The 22-year-old Luftwaffe test pilot died while making the only manned test flight of the Bachem Ba 349 Natter vertical take-off bomber. On his fatal flight, Sieber became the first human to fly a vertically-launched rocket.
